timeline.summary: Bureau of Indian Standards seized ₹1.9 Cr worth of products from Fujiyama Power's Bawal facility.
Fujiyama Power reported a fire incident at its Bawal manufacturing facility on May 6, 2026, with no casualties and insurance coverage in place.
Fujiyama Power reported ₹533.37 Cr cumulative utilization of its ₹600 Cr IPO proceeds as of March 31, 2026, extending Ratlam facility completion to June 30, 2026.
Fujiyama Power Systems approved a ₹350 Cr investment for a 1.2 GW TopCon solar cell manufacturing facility at Ratlam, slated for commercial operation from Q4FY27.
Fujiyama Power reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,654.5 Cr (up 72.3%) and Q4FY26 PAT of ₹106.3 Cr (up 107.5%), and said the Ratlam inverter and battery lines are now expected by Q1FY27 and Q2FY27.
Fujiyama commissioned its 2,000 MW Ratlam solar panel line, taking total panel capacity to 3,568 MW, with the inverter and battery lines still expected in Q1FY27 and Q2FY27.
On May 15, 2026, Fujiyama Power Systems released its Q4 and FY26 financial presentation, reporting ₹900.8 Cr quarterly revenue and commissioning 2,000 MW Ratlam panel capacity.
On May 14, 2026, Fujiyama Power commissioned its 2,000 MW solar panel manufacturing facility at Ratlam.
On May 15, 2026, Fujiyama Power Systems reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹900.8 Cr (+87.5% YoY) and commissioned a 2,000 MW solar panel line at Ratlam.

Fujiyama Power Systems Limited held an earnings call on May 15, 2026, discussing audited annual and limited reviewed quarterly financial results ended March 31, 2026, with recording available on its website.
On 22 May 2026, Fujiyama Power's board approved a ₹350 Cr, 1.2 GW TopCon solar cell facility at Ratlam, with commercial operations expected from Q1FY28.
On May 15, 2026, Fujiyama Power's Q4FY26 earnings call guided FY27 revenue 50% higher and PAT margin at 11-13%, with the Ratlam facility seen at ₹5,000 Cr peak revenue by Q4 FY28.
Pawan Kumar Garg, promoter, declares no encumbrance on Fujiyama Power Systems shares as of March 31, 2026, for promoter group and PACs.
On May 27, 2026, Fujiyama Power Systems clarified a delayed disclosure regarding a March 24, 2026 BIS surprise visit and inventory seizure at its Greater Noida facility.
On 14 August 2026, Fujiyama held its Q1FY27 earnings call, raising FY27 revenue growth guidance to 70% and detailing capacity expansions and a ₹143.6 Cr fire provision.
Fujiyama Power paid a ₹0.09 Cr penalty to resolve a BIS search and seizure case, securing the expected release of ₹2.52 Cr in seized inventory.
Fujiyama Power approved a QIP of up to ₹1,200 Cr and allotted 4.11 lakh shares under ESOP 2023 on October 15, 2026.
Fujiyama clarifies that its 1.2 GW DCR solar cell manufacturing facility at Ratlam remains on track for Q1FY28 commissioning despite China's proposed export restrictions
